nodes.asset_description: A modern, collage-style coffee ad features pour-over gear, a cup, and coffee beans arranged in four quadrants around a central white diamond reading “New Product – Premium Product.” Warm tan, peach, and orange backgrounds with stainless steel and white ceramics create a clean, minimalist look with rich dark-brown coffee accents.

A minimalist still-life shows a black pour-over dripper on a glass jar of coffee, with scattered beans, a white tube, and a second dripper on a wooden base. Warm peach-to-orange background and hard side lighting create strong shadows, highlighting the black, brown, and white tones.

Minimalist product ad featuring white cosmetic containers—a tube, jar, and dropper bottle—arranged on a peach-to-pink gradient background with coffee beans in the foreground. A translucent diamond overlay centers the text “New Product • Premium Product,” with clean studio lighting and crisp shadows.

A minimalist still life shows a white cosmetic tube beside a glass pour‑over coffee pot with a black funnel and handle, with scattered coffee beans in front. Warm directional light on a peach-orange backdrop creates long shadows and highlights the whites, glossy blacks, and rich browns.

A minimalist graphic shows a centered white diamond (a rotated square with slightly rounded corners) on a solid black background. The composition is symmetrical, high-contrast, and dominated by clean lines and negative space.
